title: Press Release Sixfold Bioscience to Present as Keynote at the 4th Dutch Antisense Therapeutics Symposium Jun 12, 2025 Read more
body_markdown:
The[two day summit](https://www.dutchantisense.org/) held in Groningen on the 12-13th of June 2025 will cover a range of topics on oligonucleotide therapeutics and delivery.


Presentation:


- 10:30am – 11:15 (local), June 12th
- “ *International Keynote Lecture: Dr. Anna Perdrix Rosell, Sixfold Bioscience, UK. Beyond the Liver: Advancing Computational and Chemical Strategies for Oligo Delivery* ”
- Chair: Jeroen Bremer
